current.text: Brooks is projected to start for Phoenix at forward, next to Jalen Green, Devin Booker, Miles Bridges and a center.
With Bridges on the team, Brooks should play less at power forward.
His 20 points per game last season came on 29% usage. Injuries to teammates and hot shooting drove it, and both faded late in the season. He shot about 38% from the field over the final two months.
Usage in Phoenix is crowded. Booker, Green, Bridges and Brooks are expected to take most of the minutes and shots.
Expect less usage and fewer points than last season now that his teammates are healthy.

The experts would not draft him in standard formats. One sees his value closer to rank 200 than 100, well below his Yahoo ADP of 114. Another took him around pick 160 but said he would take plenty of players ahead of him.
Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league. It plays 4-4-4 games in the playoff weeks and has the fewest back-to-backs.

durable.text: Brooks has a good defensive reputation. He is seen as the only clearly above-average defender in the projected Phoenix starting group.
His defense does not show up in fantasy stats. He averages about one steal and under two assists a game, and he blocks almost no shots.
His fantasy value comes mostly from threes, points and FT%. He gives little in rebounds, assists and blocks, and his FG% is low.

note: Brooks is right at the edge of our 144-player draft: Yahoo rank 141 at 3.5 USD, ESPN rank 137 at 0.7 USD. The experts see him nearer rank 160 to 200, so take him only for 1 USD at the end, as a source of threes, points and FT%. He costs you in FG% (43%) and in rebounds, assists and blocks. Early in the season, check whether he keeps last season's shot volume next to Booker, Green and Bridges. The 4-4-4 playoff schedule makes him a useful waiver pickup late in the season even if he goes undrafted.
